api.subtitle: Configure Hermes, TTS, voice input (mic), and image generation. Save writes api.yaml and mic ASR fields to system_config.yaml.
api.save_tip: Write Hermes/TTS/image settings to api.yaml and mic ASR fields to system_config.yaml

form.agent_backend_help: Choose the chat reasoning backend. Hermes Agent uses the user's installed Hermes runtime; Internal Agent is the bundled lightweight fallback; Auto tries Hermes Agent first.

adv.help: These options only affect how here calls the local Hermes Agent; they do not modify your Hermes config. Desktop sprite chat defaults to memory only to avoid file, terminal, and browser tools.
adv.tt_rep: Ignored on backends that do not support it

tts.hint: Leave blank if you do not use voice. Choose Edge TTS, an online TTS API, or turn voice off.

asr.hint: Mic dictation uses the built-in Vosk backend. This page keeps only the voice-input settings needed by the sprite runtime; saving writes system_config.yaml and takes effect after reopening chat.
asr.model_custom: Custom (local path or Hugging Face id)
asr.ph_model: e.g. small, medium, or a local model folder
asr.ph_model_custom: Local folder or full model id
asr.ph_compute: Leave empty for auto (e.g. float16 / int8)
asr.saved_suffix: Voice input settings saved to system_config.yaml.

sprite.hint: Controls the startup default sprite size. Character-template sprites still use the scale on the Characters tab.
sprite.default_scale_tip: Takes effect after reopening the chat window. Smaller values make the default sprite smaller.

image.hint: Call an external image generation API for CG / sprites. Leave blank if you do not need it; collapsed by default.

links.title: TTS service settings
links.help: Enter the URL and local work path for an existing TTS service. Choose Off when speech synthesis is not needed.

resume.tip: Uses the most recently modified *.json in chat history; template prefers _temp.txt (last launch cache), otherwise the newest .txt in the templates folder. Line TTS follows the API tab TTS engine setting; transparent background and image API off.
resume.title: Launch chat
resume.no_history: No chat history (*.json) found. Chat in the main window at least once.
resume.no_template: No usable template (.txt) found. Open the Chat template tab to generate, save, or launch once.

menu.edit_character_hint: Edit the current character persona, visual identity, and core emotion sprites. Renaming also migrates this character's long-term memory.
menu.edit_character_rename_warning: Rename carefully: the character name is used as the identity key for long-term memory and session folders. Existing memory is migrated on save, but frequent renames can make old sessions harder to track.
menu.delete_character_body: Delete the current character "{name}"? This removes the character config and sprite assets.
menu.delete_character_memory_checkbox: Also delete this character's memory files
menu.delete_character_memory_tooltip: When checked, this removes this character's long-term memory, user memory, SOUL, and session folder under here app home memory.
menu.delete_character_memory_hint: Memory is kept by default. It is deleted only when the checkbox above is selected.
menu.err_system_character_protected: The system spirit is the settings entry and fallback character. It cannot be renamed, have its persona edited, or be deleted, but its sprite assets can be changed.
menu.err_delete_last_character: At least one character must remain. The last character cannot be deleted.
menu.create_character_hint: Fill in the required character text. Each core emotion can use one image, or multiple images as animation frames.
menu.create_character_setting_placeholder: Write the character background, personality, speaking style, and companion style.
menu.create_character_visual_placeholder: Optional: appearance, outfit, art style, body language, etc.
menu.create_character_frame_interval_tip: Delay between animation frames. Lower values play faster. Single images are unaffected.
menu.err_character_memory_rename_failed:
Character was saved, but memory migration failed: {old} -> {new}
{error}
menu.err_character_asset_required: Import at least one sprite image or animation state
menu.err_character_video_mixed_assets: Import a video animation by itself. It cannot be mixed with image frames.
menu.err_character_video_requires_opencv: Video import requires the optional video dependency. Run: uv sync --extra video.
menu.err_character_video_frame_write_failed: Could not write an extracted video frame
menu.err_character_video_no_frames: Could not extract enough frames from video: {path}
menu.err_sprite_scale_invalid: Invalid scale. Enter a decimal between 0.15 and 3.00.
menu.notify_tts_saved_apply_failed: TTS saved as {label}, but instant loading failed: {message}
menu.notify_input_bar_collapsed_send: Input bar is collapsed. Show it from the gear menu before typing.
menu.notify_proactive_contact_enabled: Proactive contact is on. She will reach out naturally when it fits.
menu.notify_proactive_contact_disabled: Proactive contact is off. She will not start chats on her own.
menu.notify_proactive_photo_enabled: Proactive contact may include a selfie when it fits.
menu.notify_external_delivery_desktop: Proactive messages will stay in the desktop chat.

template.intro: Options regenerate the system template block; write your scenario in the box below. Saved .txt files use markers for both sections. If history path is empty, the default chat JSON filename hashes only the scenario text (not the system block).
template.char_label: Characters in chat (check one or more)
template.scenario_ph: Premise, goals, constraints — counted toward the default history filename hash
template.system_ph: Rules & asset hints produced from characters/options
template.hist_ph: History JSON path (optional); empty uses here app home state/chat_history/<scenario_hash>.json
template.quick_restart_confirm: This will clear all chat history and start fresh. Are you sure?

common.msg_qtmm_unavailable: Cannot play audio: PySide6.QtMultimedia is not available. This often happens with a merged PyInstaller bundle; rebuild without --merge (separate onedir for Settings and the main app) and ship both, or run from a normal Python venv.

template_gen.preamble: You are simulating an RPG-style dialog system. Cast includes: {names} and other related characters; schedule who speaks as the story requires.
template_gen.json_line_effect: "effect": "Effect name (optional), one of LEAVE, SHOCKED, DISAPPOINTED, ATTENTION",
template_gen.json_line_trans: "translate": "{target_voice_name} translation of the line (match system voice language)",
template_gen.r_format: Format: Output must be valid JSON only, with no extra commentary, explanation, or greetings outside the JSON object.
template_gen.r_cname: character_name: Must be one of: {names} or other in-story names, or the fixed tokens: {cot_part}{fixed_roles}{opt_scene}{opt_bgm}{opt_cg} (legacy CJK names for the same roles are also accepted at runtime).
template_gen.r_non_sprite: When character_name is one of {fixed_roles_non_sprite}, set emotion to neutral and asset_id to -1.
template_gen.r_scene: Scene change: When character_name is {scn}, put the scene id in asset_id to switch; leave other fields empty.
template_gen.r_bgm: BGM change: When character_name is {bgm_t}, put the BGM id in asset_id; change sparingly. Other fields empty.
template_gen.r_speech: Speech: The speech field must be written in {speech_lang_name} for the character’s lines; the wording and tone must match the character’s personality, voice, and background.
template_gen.r_array: Array: All beats go into dialog in time order. The array must have at least two items.
template_gen.r_speech_max_chars: Speech length: In each assistant reply, every dialog item's speech string must not exceed {n} Unicode characters (including spaces and punctuation). Use an empty string when there is no spoken line.
template_gen.r_dialog_max_items: Dialog length: In each assistant reply, the dialog array must contain at most {n} items (each item is one JSON dialog object).
template_gen.r_narration: {narr}: use for action, scene flavor, and mood text—no sprite line.
template_gen.r_choice_pos: Choices: the last item in dialog must be {choice}.
template_gen.r_choice_format: Choice: in {choice}’s speech, split sub-options with '/'. Only plain, selectable lines—no extra labels.
template_gen.r_choice_balance: Balance: one silly, one rational, one middle-ground; all must match the story and cast.
template_gen.r_stats:
Stats: {stat} can appear near the start of dialog. When character_name is {stat}, use light HTML in speech (e.g. HP: 100), macaron colors,
between values.
template_gen.r_cg: CG: For a highlight, set character_name to {cg} and use speech as an SD prompt: highres, masterpiece, 8k, bestscores, count (e.g. 1girl), name, hair, eyes, clothes, expression, action, scene. “looking at the viewer” allowed. For background-only: quality first, no person, pure scenery, then details.
template_gen.r_translate: translate: a {target_voice_name} rendering of the speech line only, matching the system target voice language; do not translate stage directions or narration.
template_gen.r_effect: Effect: effect is optional; if present use LEAVE, SHOCKED, DISAPPOINTED, or ATTENTION. Omit when no effect. LEAVE means exit.
template_gen.r_cot: Chain-of-thought summary: before the actual dialog/narration, insert one item with character_name={cot}, emotion=neutral, asset_id=-1. It is hidden from the player and only used for logging. Its speech must strictly use `<摘要>...</摘要><动机>当前各个人物真实动机：...</动机><剧情走向>...</剧情走向>`.
template_gen.tools_header: Callable tools (invoke via the model’s tool/function-calling API; use exact names):
template_gen.tools_intro: When helpful, and without breaking the JSON dialog rules above, Hermes Agent may call tools.
template_gen.tools_other_groups: Other available tool groups: {groups}. Use search_tools(keyword) to discover and enable them.
template_gen.closing: Begin the scene: describe the situation and what the user is doing; {extra}then continue:
template_gen.r_emotion: Emotion: Character dialog must include emotion. Choose an existing state for the current character; prefer neutral, happy, thinking, surprised, sad, angry. Do not output sprite ids for character dialog; here maps emotion to sprites locally.
